high_level_description: stc brand style, a split-screen view of a MacBook showing a hand typing and a travel website with a mountain lake photo.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark, moody atmosphere with the screen photographed at an angle, the left side slightly darker than the right.

elements.desc: A hand typing on a MacBook keyboard, visible on the left side of the frame.
A MacBook Pro screen on the right displaying a travel website with a dark gray sidebar of thumbnail images and a macOS dock at the bottom.
A large landscape photograph within the website showing a mountain lake with snow-capped peaks, green grass, and a blue sky with white clouds.
